HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.description: [IMPOSED] Rigid-body cluster inertia: locked clusters integrate a_COM = F_cluster/(N*M_INERTIAL); requires a force channel. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb
properties.description: [IMPOSED diagnostic] FTD-0281 live Coulomb clock: pre-read phi_C solve plus all-site KG potential omega_eff^2=omega0^2+2*omega0*V, V=-phi_C. GPU-ported 2026-06-20 (CUDA gpu_phase_read pre-solves d_phi_coulomb via FFT then applies the same all-site KG term). forces must stay off to avoid a second same-tick Coulomb solve.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: wave_propagation,de_broglie_clock,poisson_coulomb. Conflicts: forces. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb
properties.description: [IMPOSED diagnostic] FTD-0281 live Coulomb clock: pre-read phi_C solve plus all-site KG potential omega_eff^2=omega0^2+2*omega0*V, V=-phi_C. GPU-ported 2026-06-20 (CUDA gpu_phase_read pre-solves d_phi_coulomb via FFT then applies the same all-site KG term). forces must stay off to avoid a second same-tick Coulomb solve.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: wave_propagation,de_broglie_clock,poisson_coulomb. Conflicts: forces. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb

properties.label: Geometric gravity

The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.label: Cluster inertia
properties.description: [IMPOSED] Rigid-body cluster inertia: locked clusters integrate a_COM = F_cluster/(N*M_INERTIAL); requires a force channel. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb
properties.description: [IMPOSED diagnostic] FTD-0281 live Coulomb clock: pre-read phi_C solve plus all-site KG potential omega_eff^2=omega0^2+2*omega0*V, V=-phi_C. GPU-ported 2026-06-20 (CUDA gpu_phase_read pre-solves d_phi_coulomb via FFT then applies the same all-site KG term). forces must stay off to avoid a second same-tick Coulomb solve.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: wave_propagation,de_broglie_clock,poisson_coulomb. Conflicts: forces. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). properties.label: Geometric gravity

properties.label: Geometric gravity

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. properties.label: Geometric gravity

properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.label: De broglie clock

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.description: [IMPOSED] Rigid-body cluster inertia: locked clusters integrate a_COM = F_cluster/(N*M_INERTIAL); requires a force channel. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb
properties.description: [IMPOSED diagnostic] FTD-0281 live Coulomb clock: pre-read phi_C solve plus all-site KG potential omega_eff^2=omega0^2+2*omega0*V, V=-phi_C. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: wave_propagation,de_broglie_clock,poisson_coulomb. Conflicts: forces. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Cluster inertia
properties.description: [IMPOSED] Rigid-body cluster inertia: locked clusters integrate a_COM = F_cluster/(N*M_INERTIAL); requires a force channel. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb
properties.description: [IMPOSED diagnostic] FTD-0281 live Coulomb clock: pre-read phi_C solve plus all-site KG potential omega_eff^2=omega0^2+2*omega0*V, V=-phi_C. GPU-ported 2026-06-20 (CUDA gpu_phase_read pre-solves d_phi_coulomb via FFT then applies the same all-site KG term). forces must stay off to avoid a second same-tick Coulomb solve.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: wave_propagation,de_broglie_clock,poisson_coulomb. Conflicts: forces. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Cluster inertia
properties.description: [IMPOSED] Rigid-body cluster inertia: locked clusters integrate a_COM = F_cluster/(N*M_INERTIAL); requires a force channel. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb
properties.description: [IMPOSED diagnostic] FTD-0281 live Coulomb clock: pre-read phi_C solve plus all-site KG potential omega_eff^2=omega0^2+2*omega0*V, V=-phi_C. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.description: [IMPOSED] Rigid-body cluster inertia: locked clusters integrate a_COM = F_cluster/(N*M_INERTIAL); requires a force channel. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Db clock coulomb
properties.description: [IMPOSED diagnostic] FTD-0281 live Coulomb clock: pre-read phi_C solve plus all-site KG potential omega_eff^2=omega0^2+2*omega0*V, V=-phi_C. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

properties.label: Geometric gravity

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock
properties.description: [IMPOSED] de Broglie internal clock: Klein-Gordon mass term -omega0^2*J at manifested voxels (FTD-0271). GPU-ported 2026-06-20: the CUDA phase_read kernel applies the same -omega0^2*J KG term, gated by the toggle (default OFF => golden-neutral). Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.

properties.label: Geometric gravity
properties.description: [FTD-1016 SELECTED ENGINE EXTENSION] Replace F=G_N∇|J| with F=M_INERTIAL C² ℒ ∇ℒ from voxel.latency; native CUDA + CPU; default OFF => golden-neutral. HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. With latency_field never having run, every site has latency=0 and this term is SILENTLY ZERO — a profile that asks for gravity gets none, with no error. This is deliberately NOT a requires_ dependency: solving the field and then switching latency_field off to freeze the well is a legitimate workflow (see tests/test_frozen_well_characteristic_deflection.cpp). The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: gravity,forces. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: De broglie clock

Independent of wave_propagation: with the wave term the full KG dispersion omega^2=c^2 k^2 + omega0^2 acts; alone, each manifested voxel is the k=0 rest-frame clock oscillating at omega0.. On includes this term; Off excludes it. Requires: none. Conflicts: none. Checked before installation.
properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.

properties.label: Geometric gravity

HAZARD (audit 2026-09-02): the force is proportional to voxel.latency, which only latency_field writes. The validator sees toggles, not state, so it cannot distinguish a frozen well from an unpopulated one. Callers must ensure latency was populated at least once.. properties.recommendationBasis: Discrete states admitted by this preparation binding.
